Oortcloud.
Confirm your email to start your trial
Hello {{adminName}},
You signed up {{organisationName}} for Oortcloud, and gave this address as the administrator's email. Confirm it and your {{trialDays}}-day free trial starts straight away.

Free trial{{trialDays}} days, until {{trialEndsOn}}
This link expires{{linkExpiresAt}}
Getting started
1. Confirm your email.
Confirm and start my trial
If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
{{confirmUrl}}
2. Set your password and security key. The page that opens sets up your organisation in a few seconds, then shows a button to do this. You'll sign in to every Oortcloud and Afiax service with this one account (Afiax IAM): a password plus an authenticator app, a passkey or a security key.
3. Invite your team from your Oortcloud portal, when you're ready.
What happens next
Your portal is ready as soon as you confirm. Some services, such as your pharmacy, billing or finance system, take up to half an hour to set up: we'll email you when they're ready.
The trial is free until {{trialEndsOn}}. Before it ends we'll remind you, and you can pay by M-Pesa or card from the portal. Nothing is charged without a bill you can see first.
Need help?
Email Oortcloud support at {{supportEmail}}. {{#helpUrl}}
Read the getting-started guide{{/helpUrl}}
Didn't sign up? Ignore this email: nothing is created until the link is used, and it stops working at {{linkExpiresAt}}.
